array.string: if [[ -r /Users/daniildegtyarev/.config/roehub/roehub.env ]]; then set -a; source /Users/daniildegtyarev/.config/roehub/roehub.env; set +a; fi; CH_DATABASE_VALUE="${CH_DATABASE:-market_data}"; CH_USER_VALUE="${CH_USER:-${CLICKHOUSE_USER:-roe}}"; CH_PASSWORD_VALUE="${CH_PASSWORD:-${CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD:-}}"; cd /opt/roehub/app; exec /opt/roehub/app/.venv/bin/python -m apps.monitoring.clickhouse_exporter --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9116 --scrape-uri http://127.0.0.1:8123/ --database "$CH_DATABASE_VALUE" --user "$CH_USER_VALUE" --password "$CH_PASSWORD_VALUE" --timeout-seconds 5.0
